title: TicketEmbeddingsToDbEmbeddings
description: A row of the DynamoDB ticket_embeddings table, as process-issues writes it: a disposable cache of one project item's embedding vector (architecture §6). Partition key project_id, sort key item_id. Holds hashes and vectors derived from ticket text, never the text itself.

text_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the item's embed text (architecture §7). A different hash means the title or summary changed, so the row is a cache miss.

embedding.description: The vector as little-endian IEEE 754 float32 values, 4 bytes each, in order. DynamoDB stores the raw bytes as a Binary (B) attribute; JSON carries the same bytes as standard base64 with padding (RFC 4648 §4). The decoded bytes must be exactly 4 * dimensions long: JSON Schema cannot express this, so every implementation checks it.

embedding_model.description: The embedding model the vector was made with, e.g. text-embedding-3-small. A mismatch with the current model is a cache miss.

dimensions.description: How many float32 values the vector has. A mismatch with the current setting is a cache miss.

ttl.description: Unix seconds after which DynamoDB deletes the row. Set 180 days ahead on write, and pushed back to 180 days ahead when a run finds less than 90 days left.
